prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire Safely, Step by Step
plan.description: Learn how to change a flat tire safely, from pulling over to tightening the lug nuts. A calm, step-by-step guide for any driver.

beats.narration: A flat tire can strand you on the roadside. But you can fix it yourself in about six steps, with tools already in your trunk. Here is how.
First, find a safe, flat spot away from traffic. Turn on your hazard lights, put the car in park, and set the parking brake firmly.
Next, gather what you need. That means the spare tire, the jack, and the lug wrench. Your owner's manual shows where each one is stored.
Before lifting the car, loosen the lug nuts. Turn the wrench counterclockwise, just a half turn each. Do not remove them yet. The ground still holds the wheel steady.

props.clip_query: hands using lug wrench on wheel
props.alt: loosening wheel nuts with a wrench

beats.narration: Now place the jack at the spot the manual shows, under the car's frame. Raise the car until the flat tire is a few inches off the ground.
Unscrew the lug nuts the rest of the way and keep them together in one safe place. Then pull the flat tire straight toward you and set it aside.

props.alt: taking a tire off a car

beats.narration: Line the spare up with the wheel bolts and push it on. Thread the lug nuts back by hand first, until they are snug.
Lower the car until the tire touches the ground. Then tighten the lug nuts with the wrench, working in a star pattern across the wheel so it seats evenly.

props.text: Tighten the nuts in a star pattern, not in a circle.

beats.narration: Lower the car fully, remove the jack, and give each nut one last firm turn. Stow your tools and the flat tire in the trunk.
A spare is only temporary. Drive gently, check its pressure soon, and get the flat repaired. Stay calm, work in order, and you can handle this.
